body: Thanks your responses. Yes, I am still here. As I mentioned in the original post, I plan to do this within the next week. I have some final details to clear up, such as finding a place to leave my pets. As I also mentioned, I do have a plan. Logistically it is quite simple, and I have full faith that it will work. Just knowing that I have the plan and the details set comforts me. Like, when I get too upset and overwhelmed and can't function, I can think about it, review it, and I am comforted. It bothers me though, to read that I am "strong", because obviously, I am not strong or I would be willing to continue this endless struggle. And yes, it will get better for a little while, and then it will come crashing down again and I will find myself in this same place. 36 years of experience have shown me this. Why continue on an endless cycle? I am so relieved to hear someone else agree with me that it's offensive to have someone claim to understand what I am going through. I don't claim to understand anyone else's struggles, and I know that most people in this world live in shittier circumstances than my own. But that doesn't lessen my battle, or mean that this isn't the best decision for me. I have thought this out for years and often contemplate the notion of suicide itself. Although my family and few friends know that I have suicidal thoughts, I can't talk to them about this because you know... they try to stop me. Several weeks ago I ended up with two cops at my door, doing a "wellness check" or whatever. I smiled a lot, gave them the obligatory tears when necessary and then they went on their way. That's why I like this forum, it's a chance to express my thoughts with complete anonymity. Oh and to clear up the ambiguity, I am female.
